spring.name: Fair
spring.effect: If you Forage at least once on your turn, gain a bonus food

spring.name: Freezing
spring.effect: Immediately enter the Coop. Cannot leave the Coop. You may Eat inside during this phase.

spring.name: Nighttime
spring.effect: Once during this phase, you must perform 1 less action

spring.name: Bird Flu
spring.effect: Anyone who ends the day near another player loses 1 heart

summer.name: Sunny
summer.effect: Once during this phase, you may perform 1 extra action

summer.name: Lightning Storm
summer.effect: If you end your turn Outside, roll. If 1-2, you are struck by lightning and lose 1 health

summer.name: Flash Flood
summer.effect: All food must be discarded at the end of this phase

summer.name: Tornado
summer.effect: At the beginning of your turn, roll. If 1-2, take 1 less action on your turn.

summer.name: Heat Wave
summer.effect: Immediately exit the Coop. Cannot re-enter the Coop

fall.name: Snow
fall.effect: If you participate in the next Egg Exchange, gain a bonus 3 food. If in last phase, you may make exchanges during any turn

fall.name: Hail
fall.effect: -1 health every time you end your turn Outside

fall.name: Severe Wind
fall.effect: Discard a food or egg if you end your turn outside

fall.name: Fog
fall.effect: Roll before every attack. If 1-2, your attack misses. (Take no return damage)

eggspansion.name: Ice Melts
eggspansion.effect: At the end of each day, discard the Grubs in both locations

eggspansion.name: Mudslide
eggspansion.effect: Shuffle the rest of the Summer deck. Deal each player a personal Weather Card. That weather is in effect for them until Mudslide is replaced

eggspansion.name: Earthquake
eggspansion.effect: If you have at least one Bonus Card at the start of your turn, discard one of them, and draw a replacement before your production phase
